profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! 
My name is Ellie Kim. I'm a passionate software engineer with 6+ years of experience, bringing a fresh perspective from my diverse journey.

Starting as a data scientist at Psomagen, I dove into analyzing complex datasets and building data pipelines before transitioning to software development in California. Over the years, I’ve built a solid foundation in frontend and backend development, api integration, and data-processing. Along the way, I've navigated challenges like source control and team collaboration.

I thrive on new adventures, whether mastering a new tech stack or solving complex puzzles (you know, the kind where you feel way too happy when it works). Every hurdle is a chance to grow, even the tough ones that test your patience.

So if you're looking for a developer who's adaptable, honest, and constantly learning (with a dash of curiosity),
you’ve come to the right place! Let’s connect and build something amazing!

Technical Skills:
Frontend: Javascript, ES6, jQuery, VueJs, ReactJs
Backend: Python(FastAPI), PHP(Laravel, Codeigniter, Symfony), NodeJs, C#, Visual Basic(.NET), Shell Scripts
APIs: Restful, GraphQL, Shopify, Stripe, Mailchimp, Twillio, SAP, Heap Analytics, Google smtp/Analytics/Tags APIs, Swagger
DB: MySQL, MSSQL
Cloud: AWS RDS, S3, New Relic
Source Control: Git, Github, Bitbucket, AWS Codecommit, Docker, Jenkins
OS: Windows/Linux/Mac

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Solo-built and shipped a production mobile app: OCR-based data extraction and AI-powered personalization over a normalized PostgreSQL catalog, owning the full stack from schema design and FastAPI backend to the React Native/Expo client (Supabase)
• Developed a YouTube analytics dashboard with search, filters, and channel insights for content creators using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and PostgreSQL.
• Developed B2C e-commerce sites for lifestyle products using Shopify, customizing frontend design through Liquid templates and enhancing system architecture and implemented SEO optimization strategies.  
• Leveraging AI to optimize content, automate data entry and summarization, and improve search.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Python · PostgreSQL · API Development · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
[B2B E-commerce Marketplace Industry] 
• Modernized B2B eCommerce websites to enhance overall performance through site renewals, automated notifications, and APIs integration for buyers and sellers, using PHP Symfony, MySQL, jQuery, Ajax, HTML, CSS
• Developed core backend services with Python FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, MySQL and Pydantic, streamlining account management, checkout, and order placement, and user account/order management
• Integrate 3rd party applications such as Stripe, Spreedly, OneTrust, and Heap Analytics
•  Leveraged CI/CD pipelines using Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Docker
•  Monitored performance with AWS and New Relic to ensure production stability
• Collaborate closely with frontend developers, junior/senior software engineers, devops engineers, UI/UX designers, product managers, and QA team
• Consistently complete projects and tasks ahead of schedule, effectively managing timelines and ensuring timely delivery and high quality of results
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Python · MySQL · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · API Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
[B2C Ecommerce & Streaming Industry]
Development
• Developed RESTful APIs to integrate third-party services (Stripe, Mailchimp, Twilio, Google Analytics) for newspaper, streaming, and B2C eCommerce platforms, increasing customer engagement by 20%
• Led backend development of the payment system to transition a free service to a paid subscription model, implementing one-time and recurring payments using PHP CodeIgniter, Stripe API, and webhooks
• Documented API specifications and technical guides to support knowledge sharing and system maintenance
• Developed frontend and backend using 3rd Party APIs:
    - Stripe APIs: one time payment, subscription payment with webhooks
    - Mailchimp APIs: sending emails for events, newsletter and unsubscribe webhooks
    - Twillio APIs : sending SMS notifications to the customers who place orders
    - Google Smtp : sending receipt emails
    - Google Analytics APIs: displayed internal dashboard about websites/app traffic
• Reduced errors and maintained the system in Magento2 platform
• Built ETL pipelines with Python Selenium and MySQL to collect and analyze keyword trends from community forums and news articles.
• Analyzed website traffic and search keyword data from Splunk dashboards to generate insights for business decisions and marketing initiatives.
• Renewed a mobile sites using ReactJS

Maintenance
• QA for full system development lifecycle experience, including designing, developing and implementing test plans
• Generated statistical reports about users’ traffic from webs/apps and billing data about our products

Management
• Launched a paid service from a free service and support customer service during October2020 - December 2020
• Launched a subscription payment service on July 2021
• Documented any issues and communicate with web designers, sever engineers, and collaborating companies
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Python · JavaScript · API Development · MySQL · Stripe (Software) · Magento · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
[Logistics Industry]
Development
•  Developed both front-end and back-end web applications using Bootstrap, KendoUI, jQuery and PHP5.5 Laravel with unit testing
     - SAP ERP : for the first three months, developed supplies, purchase orders, business trips internal web sites/form/modal/upload excel, which improved employees’ work process and time
     - E-commerce fulfillment : created batch programs to get products from Shopify with GraphQL Queries & tracking shipments
     - Transport management : developed and debugged internal sites to track transport orders, warehouse items, inventory snapshot in an Agile environment, resulted in expanding business to all states from four states in USA
•  Migrated master website to new version web applications (ReactJS, PHP 7.2 Laravel, MySQL) 

Maintenance
•  Performed maintenance for legacy trucking websites(VB.NET & MS SQL) to support 500+ employees and 20 warehouses
•  Monitored EDI to provide shipment information on time

Experienced in 
Front end : ReactJS, jQuery, ES6, Ajax, RESTful/GraphQL Web APIs, Kendo UI, Bootstrap
Back end : PHP(Laravel), C#, Visual Basic (.NET), MS SQL, and MySQL
Tools : Visual Studio Code, PHPStorm, Postman, FileZilla, Linux, Git, AWS (Code Commit, EC2, RDS)

Projects
•  CRUD project with using C# and Mssql
•  To Do List with React JS
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · React.js · JavaScript · C# · MySQL · GraphQL · REST API · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microsoft SQL Server · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET)

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
[Bioinformatics Industry]
Data Science
• Utilized Python to implement analytic pipelines for Next Generation Sequencing
• Analyzed and presented monthly results of raw data and analyzed data qualities to improve our services
• Detected species of unmapped reads through BLAST
• Visualized data in venn diagrams, boxplots, correlation graphs with R and Excel
• A/B testing for updated tools and pipelines

Development
• Developed front and backend for customer to download a excel data through clicking a link in a pdf report (used Python Pandas)
• Developed to collect RNA Sequencing Metrics using Python Anaconda and numpy with refFlat file
• Developed a script to check statistical quality of raw data before running the analytic pipelines using shell scripts, resulting in providing accurate analyses

Management
• Managed data qualities, data analysis, and final reports through Laboratory Information Management System(LIMS)
• Provided RNA Sequencing reports to clients

Experienced in Excel, Python, Shell/Perl Scripts, Linux, FTP sites
positions.insights: Skills: Python · R · Linux · Shell Scripting
